title: Luxuriant Cheesy Norwegian Fish Fillet Casserole
description: A savory and comforting Norwegian dish featuring fish fillet, with a cheese-pull and wok-hei, made in a fondue pot. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: Preheat the fondue pot to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Melt the butter in the fondue pot and add the chopped onion, cooking until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cod fish fillet to the fondue pot, cooking until browned on both sides and cooked through.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, milk, salt, and black pepper.
Add the shredded norwegian cheese to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the cheese mixture over the cooked fish fillet in the fondue pot.
Cook for an additional 5 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
